comment: Formation tuning (docs/design/FORMATION_CONTRACT.md 2). Read by the Training Ground simulator / tuner and by the C++ rules. Angles are relative to the leader's heading (or to the wall's outward normal for wall.*), positive = right (UE yaw). The tuner changes only value, inside min..max.

slot.side_offset.doc: Diamond / wedge: sideways distance of the side men from the leader.

slot.back_offset.doc: Diamond / wedge: distance of the side men behind the leader.

slot.min_spacing.doc: Two members closer than this count as a spacing failure.

diamond.rear_back.doc: Diamond: the rear man straight behind the leader.

pair.side_offset.doc: Pair (2 members): the partner to the right of the leader.

pair.back_offset.doc: Pair (2 members): the partner behind the leader.

pair.scan_period.doc: Pair (2 members): one full sweep cycle of the partner (3 -> 6 -> 9 and back).

pair.scan_from.doc: Pair: the partner's sweep starts here (90 = 3 o'clock); the sweep runs clockwise through 180 (6 o'clock) to pair.scan_to.

pair.scan_to.doc: Pair: the partner's sweep ends here (270 = 9 o'clock), written above 180 so the arc runs through 6 o'clock.

column.base_back.doc: Column: the first follower behind the leader.

column.stagger.doc: Column herringbone: alternate followers this far right / left of the axis.

column.side_deg.doc: Column: right / left followers look this far off the heading.

line.fan_inner.doc: Line: the two inner members fan out this far.

line.fan_outer.doc: Line: the two outer members fan out this far.

echelon.step.doc: Echelon: each next member this far back and this far to the open side.

echelon.sector_lead.doc: Echelon: the leader looks this far to the open side.

echelon.sector_2.doc: Echelon: the second member's sector centre (open side).

echelon.sector_3.doc: Echelon: the third member's sector centre (open side).

echelon.sector_4.doc: Echelon: the last member's sector centre (open side, rear).

blizzard.back_offset.doc: Blizzard tight diamond: side men behind the leader; the rear man at twice this.

hedgehog.radius.doc: Hedgehog: members this far from the centre, facing out.

wall.spacing.doc: Wall layout: shoulder-to-shoulder spacing along the wall.

wall.face_offset.doc: Wall layout: the body centre this far off the wall face.

wall.flank_deg.doc: Wall layout: flank men look this far off the outward normal (L +, P -: 8 / 4 o'clock).

wall.neighbour_deg.doc: Wall layout, 4 members: the 4th man's neighbour turns to the centre (5 / 7 o'clock).

wall.end_deg.doc: Wall layout, 4 members: the 4th man at the end looks along the wall (3-4 / 8-9 o'clock).

pace.patrol.doc: Patrol (walk) pace of the whole squad relative to the walk speed.

move.backward_mult.doc: A member walking backwards moves at most this fraction of the walk speed.

move.catchup_mult.doc: A member far behind his slot may move this much faster than the squad pace.

facing.turn_speed.doc: Body turn rate (Godot lerp_angle turn_speed, FacingRules::StepYaw).

scan.period.doc: Patrol scan: one full sweep cycle of the side men.

scan.center_side.doc: Patrol scan: centre of the side men's sweep (P +, L -).

scan.amp_side.doc: Patrol scan: half-width of the side men's sweep (45 = 12 -> 3).

scan.amp_lead.doc: Patrol scan: the leader's light search half-width.

scan.dwell_exp.doc: Patrol scan: dwell shaping (sign(s)*|s|^exp; 1 = plain sine, lower = longer holds at the ends).

halt.side_deg.doc: Short halt: the side men hold this sector centre (2 / 10 o'clock).

classify.probe_side.doc: Terrain probe: a wall within this distance to a side marks that side as blocked.

classify.corridor_width.doc: Both sides blocked and the free width below this = corridor (column).

classify.hold_time.doc: Hysteresis: a class is kept at least this long before it may change.

classify.at_wall_dist.doc: A wall straight ahead within this distance = at_wall.

sight.fov.doc: Vision cone width standing / crouched (checks only; the game owns the real value).
